bio_en: Chanyue Ren completed her master's degree in 2026.
bio_zh: 任婵月于 2026 年获得硕士学位。

bio_en: Dr. Congcong Li focuses on the study of water storage and the variability of water resource availability. Her research aims to enhance the understanding of changes in water storage dynamics and their implications for sustainable water resource management under evolving environmental conditions.
bio_zh: 李聪聪博士主要研究水储量及水资源可利用性的变化，致力于增进对变化环境下水储量动态及其对水资源可持续管理影响的认识。

bio_en: Dr. Dongdong Kong, completed Ph.D. in 2020, and currently working at China University of Geosciences (Wuhan). Current research focuses on the limitations of soil water and groundwater on vegetation transpiration and the development of evapotranspiration models.
bio_zh: 孔冬冬博士于 2020 年获得博士学位，现就职于中国地质大学（武汉）。主要研究土壤水和地下水对植被蒸腾的限制作用，以及蒸散发模型的开发。

bio_en: Dr. Haoshan Wei focuses on hydrological modeling, with an emphasis on exploring how CO₂ influences eco-hydrological processes.
bio_zh: 魏豪杉博士主要从事水文模拟研究，重点探索 CO₂ 对生态水文过程的影响。

bio_en: Jiangmeng Li focuses on the effects of vegetation change on the regional water cycle to elucidate the water-ecology coupling mechanisms driven by climate change and human activities.
bio_zh: 李江萌主要研究植被变化对区域水循环的影响，旨在阐明气候变化和人类活动驱动下的水文—生态耦合机制。

bio_en: Jiao Wang completed her master's degree in 2026.
bio_zh: 王姣于 2026 年获得硕士学位。

bio_en: Jiayi Ding conducts research on remote sensing evapotranspiration models, focusing on advancing evapotranspiration estimation from regional to global scales, particularly in global agricultural areas and endorheic basins.
bio_zh: 丁佳怡主要研究遥感蒸散发模型，致力于改进区域至全球尺度的蒸散发估算，尤其关注全球农业区和内流流域。

bio_en: Dr. Jing Tian specializes in remote sensing hydrology, with a focus on the estimation of surface evapotranspiration and soil moisture using remote sensing techniques.
bio_zh: 田静博士主要从事遥感水文学研究，重点利用遥感技术估算地表蒸散发和土壤水分。

bio_en: Dr. Jinkai Luan, completed Ph.D. in 2023, is currently a lecturer at Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology. His research primarily focuses on the eco-hydrological effects of climate change and human activities, exploring how anthropogenic disturbances—such as artificial vegetation restoration, natural vegetation growth, land-use changes, mining and check dam—influence watershed hydrology, ecosystem, and water resource sustainability. Through a multidisciplinary approach integrating field observations, remote sensing, hydrological modeling and land model. His work has been published in journals like Journal of Hydrology, ERL, JGR-Biogeo, LDD, JEMA, Ecological Indicators and Ecological Engineering, etc.
bio_zh: 栾金凯博士于 2023 年获得博士学位，现为南京信息工程大学讲师。主要研究气候变化和人类活动的生态水文效应，探索人工植被恢复、自然植被生长、土地利用变化、采矿和淤地坝等扰动对流域水文、生态系统及水资源可持续性的影响。研究综合运用野外观测、遥感、水文模型和陆面模型等方法，成果发表于 Journal of Hydrology、ERL、JGR-Biogeo、LDD、JEMA、Ecological Indicators 和 Ecological Engineering 等期刊。
research_field_zh: 人类活动的生态水文效应

bio_en: Dr. Junlong Zhang is an Associate Professor and hydrologist at the College of Geography and Environment, Shandong Normal University. He was a visiting scholar at CSIRO Environment (2024-2025). He did his joint Ph.D. (NWU&CSIRO) in Canberra from 2015-2017 and obtained his doctor’s degree in 2017. He earned his master’s degree in 2014 and bachelor’s degree in 2012. His research interests are hydrology and water resources, ecohydrology, and global and regional hydrology. His research focuses on the fundamental theories and methods of baseflow separation, and the ecohydrological effects of vegetation dynamics. By investigating the mechanisms and modeling of baseflow and related hydrological processes, he aims to contribute to catchment ecological restoration and water resources management.
bio_zh: 张军龙博士为山东师范大学地理与环境学院副教授、水文学者，2024—2025 年在澳大利亚 CSIRO Environment 任访问学者，2015—2017 年在堪培拉开展西北大学与 CSIRO 联合博士研究，分别于 2017 年、2014 年和 2012 年获得博士、硕士和学士学位。研究兴趣包括水文水资源、生态水文学及全球与区域水文学，重点关注基流分割的基础理论与方法，以及植被动态的生态水文效应。通过研究基流及相关水文过程的机制与模拟，为流域生态修复和水资源管理提供支持。

bio_en: Liwen Zhang focuses on the response relationship of lake hydrological elements to the influencing factors of drought in the basin.
bio_zh: 张力文主要研究湖泊水文要素与流域干旱影响因素之间的响应关系。

bio_en: Longhao Wang received the B.S. degree from Hohai University, he is currently using AI models to simulate meteorological and hydrological processes, with a focus on coupling physical processes with machine learning for large-scale forecasting. He was selected for the CAST 2026 doctoral student talent development program.
bio_zh: 王龙浩为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所自然地理学博士研究生，导师为张永强研究员。聚焦人工智能与物理过程耦合、次季节—季节水文气象预报、GRACE 与蒸散发。2026 年入选中国科协青年科技人才培育工程博士生专项计划。

bio_en: Dr. Muhammad Abrar Faiz, completed his Ph.D. in 2018 and is currently a Professor at Northeast Agricultural University in Harbin, China. His research focuses on ecosystem responses to regional climate change, streamflow variability, precipitation time-series fluctuations, drought monitoring, hydrological modeling, and drought indices. His work has appeared in journals such as the Journal of Advanced Research, Journal of Hydrology, Journal of Cleaner Production, and Agricultural Water Management, among others. He aims to improve early warning of climate-driven vegetation stress through coupled hydrological models and drought-index analytics. In 2026, Muhammad Abrar Faiz received NSFC funding for foreign young scholars (Category B).
bio_zh:
费辞为课题组校友，现任东北农业大学教授。他的研究围绕区域气候变化下的水文响应、径流变异、干旱指数及生态系统响应展开，并持续与团队开展合作。

研究方向：水文气候极端事件、径流变化、干旱监测与水文模拟。2026 年获外国青年 B 类项目资助。

bio_en: Dr. Muhammad Naeem, completed his Ph.D. in 2025 in hydrology and surface water resources, with a specialized focus on lake changes and their impacts on both human activities and climate dynamics. Currently, Dr. Naeem is serving as a postdoctoral researcher at Shenzhen University. .
bio_zh: Muhammad Naeem 博士于 2025 年获得水文与地表水资源方向博士学位，重点研究湖泊变化及其对人类活动和气候动态的影响，现为深圳大学博士后。

bio_en: Dr. Ning Ma focuses on surface hydrological processes, with a particular emphasis on the mechanisms and dynamics of evapotranspiration. In 2026, Ning Ma received NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category B).
bio_zh:
马宁为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所副研究员。他关注地表水文过程，结合观测、模型与遥感方法研究陆气水热交换及水循环对气候变化的响应。

研究方向：蒸散发过程与机理、陆面过程观测与模拟、生态水文和遥感水文。2026 年获青年科学基金项目（B 类）资助。

bio_en: Dr. Qi Huang, completed Ph.D. in 2025, is currently an assistant professor at National Institute of Natural Hazards, China. Her researches focus on simulation and analysis of changes on hydrological regimes, as well as hydrological forecasting in ungauged basins. She is one of the recipients of the 2021 International Association of Chinese Youth in Water Sciences (CYwater) Outstanding Paper Award, Liu Guangwen Scholarship, National Inspirational Scholarship and Outstanding Graduate Student of IGSNRR and SCU.Over the past five years, She has published multiple papers in Water Resources Research, Catena, Journal of Hydrology: regional studies, etc.
bio_zh: 黄琦博士于 2025 年获得博士学位，现任中国国家自然灾害防治研究院助理研究员，主要研究水文情势变化的模拟与分析，以及无资料流域水文预报。曾获 2021 年国际华人青年水科学协会（CYwater）优秀论文奖、刘光文奖学金、国家励志奖学金，以及中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所和四川大学优秀毕业研究生等荣誉。近五年在 Water Resources Research、Catena 和 Journal of Hydrology: Regional Studies 等期刊发表多篇论文。

bio_en: Dr. Shaoyang He, completed Ph.D. in 2025. She has published papers in journals such as Earth System Science Data and is currently engaged in entrepreneurial work.
bio_zh: 何韶阳博士于 2025 年获得博士学位，曾在 Earth System Science Data 等期刊发表论文，目前从事创业工作。

bio_en: Shengyu Zou focuses on hydrological modeling based on remote sensing data and 3D reconstruction of hydrological scenes.
bio_zh: 邹圣羽主要研究基于遥感数据的水文模拟与水文场景三维重建。

bio_en: Shijia Wang completed his master’s degree in 2025.
bio_zh: 王世佳于 2025 年获得硕士学位。

bio_en: Wenjie Hou dedicate to the simulation of remote sensing evapotranspiration.
bio_zh: 侯文杰主要从事遥感蒸散发模拟研究。

bio_en: Wenwen Zhang focuses on centennial-scale runoff changes and attribution analysis across major global river basins.
bio_zh: 张雯雯主要研究全球主要流域百年尺度径流变化及其归因。

bio_en: Dr. Xian Wang focuses on integrating artificial intelligence with hydrology to enhance the simulation and prediction of hydrological processes. In 2026, Xian Wang received NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category C).
bio_zh:
王显为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所博士后，聚焦人工智能与水文学的融合，研究如何提升水文过程模拟与预测能力。

研究方向：人工智能水文学、水文过程模拟与预测。2026 年获青年科学基金项目（C 类）资助。

bio_en: Dr. Xiaojie Li specializes in the interactions between agricultural water use and hydrological processes under a changing environment. Her work focuses on the mechanisms and processes of agricultural evapotranspiration, water use efficiency, and hydrological responses to climate change and human activities.
bio_zh: 李晓婕博士主要研究变化环境下农业用水与水文过程的相互作用，重点关注农业蒸散发的机制与过程、用水效率，以及水文过程对气候变化和人类活动的响应。

bio_en: Dr. Xingmin Shao, completed Ph.D. in 2024, is currently employed at China-Singapore Guangzhou Knowledge City Collaboration Affairs Office, working in urban planning.
bio_zh: 邵杏敏博士于 2024 年获得博士学位，现就职于中新广州知识城合作事务办公室，从事城市规划工作。

bio_en: Xinhai Wei focuses on ecohydrology
bio_zh: 韦鑫海主要从事生态水文学研究。

bio_en: Dr. Xuanze Zhang studies the feedback interactions between the global carbon cycle and climate change. His research focuses on the mechanisms and processes of evapotranspiration, as well as the dynamics and underlying principles of drought events. In July 2026, he was appointed Editor of Agricultural and Forest Meteorology.
bio_zh: 张选泽研究全球碳循环与气候变化之间的反馈，关注蒸散发机制、干旱过程、生态水文与陆面模拟。2026 年 7 月担任 Agricultural and Forest Meteorology 编辑（Editor）。

bio_en: Xuening Yang focuses on optimizing agricultural water management using crop modeling, researching the water-food-energy nexus in river basins, and the sustainable utilization of agricultural water resources under drought stress.
bio_zh: 杨雪宁主要利用作物模型优化农业用水管理，研究流域水—粮食—能源关联，以及干旱胁迫下农业水资源的可持续利用。

bio_en: Yalin Xie focuses on machine learning–based inversion of soil moisture spatial patterns and implications for drought monitoring.
bio_zh: 谢雅琳主要研究基于机器学习的土壤水分空间格局反演及其在干旱监测中的应用。

bio_en: Dr. Yijing Cao completed her postdoctoral research.
bio_zh: 曹一晶博士已完成博士后研究。

bio_en: Yiwen Luo focus on regional and global changes in evapotranspiration, as well as the effects of vegetation changes on water and carbon dynamics over the Tibetan Plateau.
bio_zh: 罗洢雯主要研究区域与全球蒸散发变化，以及植被变化对青藏高原水碳动态的影响。

bio_en: Yizhe Ma focuses on the eco-hydrological impacts of droughts and evapotranspiration models. His research aims to understand the drought resilience under climate change, providing insights into the hydrological effects of ecosystems' responses to drought.
bio_zh: 马亦哲主要研究干旱的生态水文影响与蒸散发模型，旨在理解气候变化背景下的干旱韧性，揭示生态系统干旱响应的水文效应。

research_field: Global and regional hydrology and water resources
bio_en: Prof. Yongqiang Zhang is a hydrologist specializing in hydrology and water resources. His research focuses on understanding the mechanisms and processes of global evapotranspiration, exploring eco-hydrological processes, and advancing hydrological modeling, prediction, and projection through remote sensing techniques. In 2026, he received the AGU Joanne Simpson Medal and became an AGU Fellow.
bio_zh: 张永强研究员从事全球与区域水文及水资源研究，关注蒸散发机制、生态水文过程以及遥感支持的水文模拟、预测与预估。2026 年荣获 AGU Joanne Simpson 奖章并当选 AGU 会士。
research_field_zh: 全球与区域水文及水资源

bio_en: Yushi Zheng focuses on atmospheric precipitation forecasting and hydrological simulation.
bio_zh: 郑雨诗主要研究大气降水预报与水文模拟。

bio_en: Yuxuan Xie focuses on evapotranspiration modeling and ecohydrological models development. His research aims to reveal the response mechanisms of ecohydrological processes to climate change and to deepen our understanding of the underlying principles.
bio_zh: 谢宇轩主要研究蒸散发模拟和生态水文模型开发，旨在揭示生态水文过程对气候变化的响应机制，深化对其内在规律的认识。

bio_en: Yuyin Chen completed her master’s degree in 2024 and is currently working at ByteDance.
bio_zh: 陈昱吟于 2024 年获得硕士学位，现就职于字节跳动。

bio_en: Dr. Zhen Huang focuses on surface and subsurface hydrological modeling, hydrological forecasting, and water resources management.Specifically, his work aims to improve the representation of hydrological processes through integrated surface–subsurface models, explore the impacts of climate and land surface changes on water resources, and develop advanced forecasting frameworks that support water management and decision-making.
bio_zh: 黄振博士主要研究地表与地下水文模拟、水文预报及水资源管理。通过地表—地下耦合模型改进水文过程表征，探索气候和陆面变化对水资源的影响，并开发支持水资源管理与决策的先进预报框架。

bio_en: Dr. Zhenwu Xu specializes in hydroclimate extremes. His research focuses on hydrological responses to disturbances caused by droughts, wildfires, and human activities, aiming to advance understanding of the resilience and evolution of Earth’s water resources and ecosystems. In 2026, Zhenwu Xu received NSFC Young Scientists Fund (Category C).
bio_zh:
许振武为中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所博士后，2024 年于中国科学院大学获得博士学位，博士期间曾赴维也纳工业大学接受联合研究训练。他整合卫星观测、实测资料与分布式生态水文模型，研究干旱、野火及人类活动扰动下的水文响应，并参与 PML 蒸散发与生产力模型的数据和方法开发。

研究方向：水文气候极端事件、生态水文与水文系统韧性。2026 年获青年科学基金项目（C 类）资助。

bio_en: Zhiye Cao focuses on using crop modeling to investigate crop resilience mechanisms under drought stress.
bio_zh: 曹致业主要利用作物模型研究干旱胁迫下作物的韧性机制。

bio_en: Dr. Zixuan Tang completed Ph.D. in 2026 and is currently a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Potsdam. His research focuses on anthropogenic impacts (reservoirs and water consumption) on hydrological processes, sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) hydrological extreme forecasting, and global hydrological model behaviour.
bio_zh: 唐子轩博士于 2026 年获得博士学位，现为波茨坦大学博士后。主要研究人类活动（水库和用水）对水文过程的影响、次季节至季节（S2S）水文极端事件预报，以及全球水文模型的行为特征。
research_field_zh: 水文极端事件；人类活动影响
